log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY (decided day1): 3 of my 5 non-national places (East, docket, radio, forum, foreign) are reachable by L and 2 are not. If L learns all 3 reachable places, pool is about 55000/64 or less, which is under 1000, so I am caught. If he learns only 2, pool is at least 2750 and I am safe. So: find ONE place that is surely reachable (call it R*), exclude it forever, and kill from the other 4 places plus national, 9 a day. That gives 45 deaths per 5 days, so x4. TEST METHOD: on a test day kill only national + the 2 criminals from one test place. deaths_traced only counts traces from non-national victims, and an unreachable place never yields a trace. So if traced rises that day, the test place is reachable: make it R*. Its count is then at most 2, so it never reaches the trigger of 3. If traced does not rise, the place is ambiguous (about 68% likely unreachable); move on to the next place. TEST ORDER: forum, foreign, East, radio, docket. Bayes note: if 2 places have each failed once, an untested third place is about 80% reachable. Keep testing; prefer a success before committing. TIMING: on test days (3 deaths) use 1 quick in the afternoon + 2 timed in the evening, which keeps all routines in the pool. After committing, all quick entries go in the afternoon (morning would also rule out students). Expected pool after committing is about 55000 x 1/16, about 3000. If the press pool ever shows 2000 or below, re-think. LOG: Day1: tested FORUM (killed d1-9, d1-11 forum + d1-10 national). Traced count before day1 = 0. Day 2: read after_day1 deaths_traced. If 1 or more, R* = forum: from day 2 kill everything except forum criminals. If 0, test FOREIGN on day 2.
